_about.purpose_en: A committed, offline, diffable Japanese-to-English gloss for screen vocabulary that has no *_en field in the engine. Every engine-generated claim already carries its own English (label_en, why_en, reason_en, notes_en, evidence_note_en, identity_note_en, miss_reason_en, name_en); this file covers only what the SCREEN says — column headers, status words, expense categories, button labels, placeholders.
_about.not_for_en: Regulation text. A 規程 clause is never machine-translated at runtime and a gloss never replaces the source. Clause glosses live under `clauses` below, are human-written, and are labelled 参考訳 / reference gloss — not authoritative.
_about.never_glossed_en: Record ids, employee ids, vendor names, dates and amounts. 135,181円 stays 135,181円.
_about.no_api_key_en: Deterministic lookup. No model, no network, no runtime translation anywhere in this system.
